<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
softmax(x: np.ndarray, axis: int = -1) -> np.ndarray
```

Part of [`evoxc_hf.reference`](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/)

Numerically stable softmax over `axis`.

Computes `exp(x - max(x, axis)) / sum(exp(x - max(x, axis)), axis)`, i.e.
the maximum is subtracted first so no `exp` term can overflow.

## Parameters

- `x` · `np.ndarray` — Real array of any rank with at least one dimension.

- `axis` · `int` — Axis to normalise over (default: last).

## Returns

- `np.ndarray` — `float32` array with `x.shape`; every slice along `axis` sums to `1.0` (up to f32 rounding).  `float64` input is downcast.

## Raises

- `ValueError` — If `x` is a 0-d scalar (nothing to normalise over) or
  `axis` is out of range.

- `TypeError` — If `x` is not real-valued.
